versions.changelog:
Initial release of the sugar-crack-video skill.

- Generate vertical, satisfying sugar-shell crack and pour short videos (text-to-video or dessert image to shell shatter and flowing center motion).
- Designed for food ASMR cuts: caramel crack, jelly wobble, lava pour, and shell snap effects.
- Requires WERYAI_API_KEY and Node.js 18+; uses WeryAI API with strict environmental and command dependencies.
- Mandatory prompt expansion: always transforms short user requests into full video production prompts before sending to the API.
- Includes step-by-step workflow, security best practices, explicit local image handling guidance, and clear API parameter boundaries.
- All outputs are 9:16 vertical short video clips, with confirmation required before generation.
